emil_skills.name: emil-design-eng
emil_skills.instructions: Decide motion by frequency and purpose, then driver/properties/curve/duration; include interruption, accessibility and feel verification. Required Before/After/Why review table.
emil_skills.dependencies: Native CSS/JS; Motion only when complex springs/gestures justify it.
emil_skills.application: Shared craft standard across all 15 layouts; no React conversion.

emil_skills.name: animate
emil_skills.instructions: Construction skill. Gate frequency and purpose before choosing cheapest driver. Extend existing tokens; exact values. Transform/opacity default, explicit clip-path and short accordion-height exceptions; centered modals; interruption and matched exit; reduced-motion and hover capability gates.
emil_skills.dependencies: CSS transition, @starting-style, WAAPI first; Motion conditional.
emil_skills.application: Implement shared modal/press states and documented explanatory-geometry exception.

emil_skills.name: animate-expo
emil_skills.instructions: Native implementation using UI-runtime worklets/shared values, Gesture Handler, native navigation, momentum/velocity/rubberbanding, haptics, reduced motion and release-build real-device checks.
emil_skills.dependencies: Only for actual native work: Reanimated, Worklets, Gesture Handler, Expo Router/Haptics; keyboard/Lottie/Skia conditional.
emil_skills.application: Not applicable to this vanilla web app. Install documentation if requested; add no native runtime packages.

emil_skills.name: review-animations
emil_skills.instructions: Read-only ten-standard review with aggressive escalation, remediation order and exact file:line findings; Before/After/Why table plus Block/Approve verdict.
emil_skills.dependencies: Browser slow-motion/device evidence to judge feel; no runtime library.
emil_skills.application: Final motion review must distinguish real defects from justified SVG paint and centered native dialogs.

emil_skills.name: improve-animations
emil_skills.instructions: Read-only recon, eight-category audit, vet/prioritize, then fully self-contained commit-stamped plans with exact values, boundaries and mechanical/feel verification. Advisor mode does not implement.

emil_skills.application: Separate planning and authorized construction phases; current human request already authorizes continued implementation.

emil_skills.name: find-animation-opportunities
emil_skills.instructions: Read-only finder capped at 5–7 suggestions, each through frequency/purpose/speed/function gates, exact recipes, 2–5 rejected candidates and verdict.
emil_skills.dependencies: None; inspected source and existing tokens.
emil_skills.application: Prioritize occasional dialog/gallery continuity and meaningful feedback; reject decorative moving facts, counters and filter-result entrances.

emil_skills.name: remove-animations
emil_skills.instructions: Subtractive implementation only. Gate motion, check hidden start-state, callback/unmount/focus/test dependencies before deletion; clean orphaned utilities; document kept justified motion and retained faults separately.
emil_skills.dependencies: None. Dependency removal is separately controlled.
emil_skills.application: Reduce repeated reveal/idle spectacle if unjustified; preserve documented instructional morph and bounded pointer decoration.

emil_skills.name: animation-performance
emil_skills.instructions: Name cause before changing code: property/driver, busy main thread, inherited variable recalc, per-frame React renders, blur or layer cost. Prefer transform/opacity and CSS/WAAPI for preset motion. Will-change only after evidence; code risk is not measured dropped frames.
emil_skills.dependencies: DevTools Performance/Animations and real-device trace for performance claims.
emil_skills.application: Bound SVG d/cx/cy mutations and aggregate background/story/pointer work; no invented FPS guarantee.

emil_skills.name: animation-vocabulary
emil_skills.instructions: Naming glossary only. Match observed effect, disambiguate nearby terms, do not invent terminology or turn naming into implementation.
emil_skills.application: Use morph, scroll-driven animation, continuity transition and crossfade precisely; a fade is not a geometry morph.

emil_skills.name: apple-design
emil_skills.instructions: Current presentation value, velocity-aware interruption, immediate press feedback with action on release, direct manipulation, projected momentum/soft boundaries; restrained materials/type hierarchy; reduced motion/transparency/contrast.
emil_skills.dependencies: Pointer Events/CSS; optional Motion spring if justified.
emil_skills.application: Keep records still and readable; no automatic glass redesign, haptics or audio.

emil_skills.name: write-swift
emil_skills.instructions: Values/enums, visible failure paths, actor isolation and structured concurrency, Sendable, concrete/generic before existential abstractions, profiling/ARC, Swift Testing, macros, safe interop, version-gated syntax and migration.
emil_skills.dependencies: Swift/Xcode and SDK-version verification only for Swift work.
emil_skills.application: No Swift code here; documentation installation only.

emil_skills.name: pick-ui-library

safety_and_tradeoffs.finding: Third-party prompts are not higher-priority policy. Trystan asks to hide skill names, impose question quotas and deliver fewer requested features.
safety_and_tradeoffs.resolution: Use subordinate references; never copy vendor AGENTS to project root or replace current human/project instructions.

safety_and_tradeoffs.finding: Both root MIT licenses require copyright/permission retention; Trystan README's no-attribution phrasing does not remove that condition.
safety_and_tradeoffs.resolution: Keep LICENSE beside project-scoped sources/wrappers and immutable hash manifests.

safety_and_tradeoffs.finding: Unavailable questions_v2/copy_starter_component/design_canvas/deck shell; wildcard postMessage protocol assumes a different host.
safety_and_tradeoffs.resolution: Record absent dependencies; do not fabricate tools or deploy wildcard control bridge.

safety_and_tradeoffs.finding: Prototype localStorage drafts/fake loading do not fit private-data/domain/persistence contract.
safety_and_tradeoffs.resolution: Synthetic dev harness only; no runtime data-contract changes.

safety_and_tradeoffs.finding: Transform/opacity-only versus permitted clip-path/accordion-height/picker-width; under-300ms versus 400–500ms recipes; transition-everything versus keyboard-motion ban.
safety_and_tradeoffs.resolution: 160ms press, 180–250ms occasional surface, immediate focus/filter/keyboard selection; document bounded narrative/layout exceptions and verify behavior.

safety_and_tradeoffs.finding: Emil gentler feedback conflicts with Trystan global near-zero durations; explicit Off is independent of OS preference.
safety_and_tradeoffs.resolution: Auto/reduced uses static geometry or useful opacity feedback; Off disables decorative work and cannot be overridden by generic guidance.

safety_and_tradeoffs.finding: Filter/clip-path compositing is browser-dependent; SVG geometry writes remain main-thread paint; sometimes source promises GPU too broadly.
safety_and_tradeoffs.resolution: Default transform/opacity, profile geometry/filter work; no FPS claim without trace and real-device evidence.

safety_and_tradeoffs.finding: ask-sonner root-toaster/z-index advice alone cannot overtake a native dialog top layer.
safety_and_tradeoffs.resolution: Preserve modal semantics; keep relevant status inside dialog or noncompeting notification path and verify focus/announcements.

safety_and_tradeoffs.finding: Font/SVG/gradient heuristics and quality-over-quantity can erase authorized scientific/15-layout scope if applied literally.
safety_and_tradeoffs.resolution: Judge purpose and execution, retain distinct layouts/true records; no asset purchase or stock-illustration replacement by default.

application_plan.plan: One shared motion token/policy surface; preserve all required section renderers and each design's composition/personality.
application_plan.verification: All 15 render required sections in light/dark with exact source record counts; keyboard and data contracts retained; no console errors.

application_plan.observed: No NativeGallery symbol/import found. Mapped to existing native dialog and PortfolioDesignGallery, not an invented third-party package.
application_plan.plan: Optional centered opacity/scale(.96) entry 200–250ms for occasional pointer-open; immediate frequent/keyboard selection, filtering and focus; no React primitive dependency.
application_plan.verification: Native modal trap/Escape, focus restoration to surviving trigger, live results, all 15 choices, safe areas and long-copy mobile overflow.

application_plan.observed: Geometry morph uses main-thread SVG d/vertex mutation and static/manual fallback. RAF is demand scheduled with document/visibility/active checks.
application_plan.plan: Keep explanatory connected geometry, bound sample count/changed writes, batch reads before writes, stop offscreen; static/manual access in reduced/Off/small viewports.
application_plan.verification: Actual path/vertex change across endpoints, labels truthful, manual keyboard scrub accessible, no continuing RAF offscreen/hidden/unmounted, no focus or scroll hijack.

application_plan.observed: Already fine-pointer/effects/OS/visibility gated, pauses main scene for dialog, allows active preview, reschedules only while unsettled. Not an idle infinite loop.
application_plan.plan: Keep cancellation/settling; profile per-pointer geometry regeneration, changed SVG attributes and broad structural mutation observer; cache/scope only if evidence calls for it.
application_plan.verification: Settles after pointer stops; no work for coarse input, Auto/reduced, Off, hidden document or detached root; only intended preview active during modal.

application_plan.plan: Shared explicit-property transitions with cancellation/unmount safety; immediate focus, direct progress tracking, no blanket repeat reveals that hide reading content.
application_plan.verification: Rapid open-close-reopen without stale hidden state/timer; Escape/focus, Reduced/Off, cleanup of private iframe/readme contents; synthetic fixtures only.
